race.comment: VEYEPEE (9) resumes. He looked good in his maiden campaign, winning impressively on debut at Geelong and again at Caulfield Heath before being sent out a $6 chance to Salty Pearl in a rich race and battling away for sixth. Kicks off at a good trip, Shinn booked from the inside gate and he looks one that can measure up to better races. MELEK (18) resumes off a long break having not been seen since winning well over this trip on debut at Caulfield Heath. He's been scratched a few times, late betting will be key if he does line up. CASHOUT (11) resumed with a comfortable win at Pakenham Synthetic over 1400m and looks to have come back very well. Hard to catch again with the race fitness. PRINCE OF BROOKY (16) looks ready for this trip now and back onto turf is fine, he can measure up on an each-way basis.
